name: docs-cleaner
description: >- Consolidates redundant documentation while preserving all valuable content; keeps a doc set truthful after things change. Two modes. (1) POST-CHANGE GOVERNANCE — when code, scripts, config, env vars, ports, paths, deployment, auth, tests, or a documented procedure changed; also "which docs are now wrong", "check docs for inconsistencies", "过时的命令/路径", "文档同步".
